title: AP Chemistry Fixture Unit 2 Challenge Lab

items.title: Unknown solid classification
items.prompt: An unknown solid has a high melting point, does not conduct electricity as a solid, and conducts when molten. Which broad structural model is most consistent with these observations?
items.answer_guide: An ionic-solid model is consistent. The ions are fixed in the solid lattice and become mobile when the lattice melts, allowing charge to move.
items.story_hint: Return to the charged-tile lattice and ask when the charged particles can move.
items.success_criterion: Identify an ionic solid and connect conductivity to ion mobility.
